description: Canonical caller-stub contract for the .github/workflows/*.yml stubs in every member repo. Each member stub is a thin wrapper that `uses:` one of concord's reusable workflows; this file is the machine-readable source of truth for the fields that must never drift — the `uses:` workflow, its `@<ref>` channel, and the `permissions:` block. Members call `@<ref>` (top-level `ref`, the stable channel). A canary member (the `canary` map, member id -> hub ref) calls `@<its ref>` and must pass `concord-ref: <its ref>` to every reusable workflow that declares a `concord-ref` input, so the workflow and the hub files it loads come from the same ref. A non-canary member omits `concord-ref` (the default is the stable ref). Promotion to the stable ref is `make promote`. Enforced by scripts/check-workflow-stubs.py (see `make stubs-check`). Per-repo variation — `on:` triggers, other `with:` inputs (curseforge-id, modrinth-id, mod-id), and concurrency — is deliberately NOT compared, so a member stays free to set them. Edit this file when a reusable workflow's required caller permissions or the channel assignment change, and keep the matching header-comment stub in the reusable workflow in step.
